    First CourseTruffled Gruyere gougeresScuba gear off and a tuxedo underneath. Swiss cheese puffs, warm from the oven.How to make it125ml milk125ml water100g butter, diced150g plain flour4 eggs150g Gruyere, finely grated1 tsp Dijon mustard1/4 tsp ground nutmeg1 tsp truffle oil1 tsp sea salt flakesBring the milk, water, butter and a pinch of salt to the boil, tip in the flour and beat over the heat until the dough leaves the sides.Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy.Beat in most of the Gruyere with the mustard and nutmeg, pipe walnut-sized balls onto lined trays and top with the rest of the cheese.Bake at 200°C until puffed and deep golden, without opening the oven.Brush the hot puffs with the truffle oil and scatter with sea salt.Florida Keys prawn cocktailWarheads hidden in antique statues. Lime and avocado with Marie Rose sauce.How to make it500g cooked king prawns, peeled2 baby cos lettuces, shredded1 avocado, diced2 limes125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp hot sauce1/4 tsp smoked paprika1 small bunch chives, snippedStir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, hot sauce and the juice of 1 lime into a pink sauce.Toss the avocado with a squeeze of lime so it stays green.Layer the lettuce and avocado in 4 glasses and pile the prawns on top.Spoon over the sauce, dust with paprika, scatter chives and hang a lime wedge on each glass.Gib's van jerkyI've been in the van for 15 years, Harry.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Main CourseCode name Doris chicken KievHelen hoped for Natasha and got Doris. Garlic butter centre, crisp crumb, buttery mash.How to make it4 chicken breasts100g butter, softened3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped75g plain flour2 eggs, beaten150g panko breadcrumbs250ml vegetable oil, for frying1kg floury potatoes, peeled125ml milk150g green beansMash the butter with the garlic and parsley, roll into a log and freeze until firm.Cut a deep pocket in each breast, push in a slice of the butter and press closed.Dip in flour, egg and panko, then egg and panko again, and chill for 10 minutes.Fry in hot oil until golden all over, then finish in the oven at 200°C until cooked through.Meanwhile boil the potatoes and mash with a knob of butter and the milk, and steam the beans.Rest the Kievs for 2 minutes and serve with the mash and beans.Seven Mile Bridge snapperHarriers blow up the Seven Mile Bridge. Crisp-skin snapper over coconut rice.How to make it4 x 180g snapper fillets, skin on2 tbsp olive oil1 tsp ground allspice300g jasmine rice400ml tin coconut milk1 mango, diced1/2 red onion, finely diced1 long red chilli, finely chopped1 small bunch coriander, chopped2 limesSimmer the rice with the coconut milk, 250ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, until tender.Mix the mango, onion, chilli, coriander and the juice of 1 lime for the salsa.Rub the snapper with oil, allspice and salt and cook skin down in a hot pan until crisp, then turn for a minute.Serve the fish on the rice with the salsa piled on top and lime wedges.DessertMissed birthday chocolate layer cakeThe birthday party Harry missed. Dark chocolate sponge and fudge icing.How to make it225g plain flour300g caster sugar60g cocoa powder, plus 30g for the icing1 1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda2 eggs250ml buttermilk125ml vegetable oil250ml hot strong coffee200g dark chocolate, chopped150g butter, softened250g icing sugar4 birthday candlesWhisk the flour, sugar, 60g cocoa and bicarb, then whisk in the eggs, buttermilk, oil and hot coffee to a thin batter.Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake at 180°C until a skewer comes out clean.Cool completely.Melt the chocolate, beat the butter with the icing sugar and remaining cocoa, then beat in the chocolate.Sandwich and cover the cakes with the icing and stand the candles on top.To ToastJuno Skinner's champagne cocktailJuno pours champagne holding her Beretta. Brut, cognac and a bitters-soaked sugar cube.How to make it1 x 750ml bottle brut champagne60ml cognac4 sugar cubes1 tsp Angostura bitters1 orange, for peelDrop a sugar cube soaked with a few drops of bitters into each chilled flute.Add 15ml cognac, top slowly with champagne and twist a strip of orange peel over each.Iced water, trays includedGib's wife number two took the ice cube trays.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
